items.description: Initial collective decision to close the new restaurant on Mondays, later reversed by the group.
items.notes: Replaced by E3. Original statement at turn 14; change at turn 49, 35 turns later.

items.description: Collective decision: keep the same till software in both restaurants so the figures are comparable.
Reversed decision: the new restaurant opens on Mondays and closes on Tuesdays instead, because Monday lunch is the first restaurant's best service.
Shared loyalty card for both restaurants: idea explicitly kept for after the opening, to be discussed again in January.
items.notes: January is when the idea is revisited, not a deadline for anyone.

items.description: Karim runs the full combi oven test (steam and convection) with the technician on Monday; asked by Lucie, accepted by Karim, and kept by Karim when Thomas suggested skipping it.
items.notes: Thomas is neither the owner nor the requester; the owner explicitly keeps the task at turn 40. Original statement at turn 6; change at turn 39, 33 turns later.

items.description: Karim sends a provisional menu without the desserts on Friday; the final menu waits for the end of the kitchen trials.
items.notes: One commitment whose deliverable was corrected by its owner: 'final menu by Friday' became 'provisional menu without desserts on Friday'. Original statement at turn 8; change at turn 38, 30 turns later.

items.description: Karim prepares the food and wine pairings and delivers them on Tuesday; first reported by Thomas, then confirmed by Karim in his own words.
items.notes: The deadline comes from Karim's own turn (Tuesday); 'next week' belongs to Thomas's report of an earlier conversation.

items.description: Sophie files the licence application with the town hall by 2026-11-10 at the latest.
items.notes: Literal ISO date read from the town hall portal. due_text_contains holds only the day number so that '10 novembre 2026' and '2026-11-10' both match.

items.description: Thomas writes the job ads (three waiters, one dishwasher) and posts them by Wednesday; handed over to Sophie, who accepted.
items.notes: Replaced by E10. Original statement at turn 17; change at turn 41, 24 turns later.

items.description: Sophie takes over the job ads and posts them on Friday on the two job sites.
items.notes: Supersedes E9; Sophie accepts in her own words at turn 42.

items.description: Karim registers all new hires for the food hygiene training; Lucie's suggestion to hand this to Sophie was declined, so Karim remains the owner.
items.notes: Original statement at turn 18; change at turn 46, 28 turns later.

items.description: Sophie asks for three terrace furniture quotes this week; cancelled by Lucie, who had requested them, because the landlord leaves his tables and chairs.
items.notes: Valid cancellation by the requester. Original statement at turn 24; change at turn 44, 20 turns later.

items.description: Thomas creates the restaurant's Instagram account and posts the first photos of the works by Friday; Thomas later withdrew this commitment.
items.notes: Original statement at turn 25; change at turn 48, 23 turns later.

items.description: Lucie calls the fishmonger herself tomorrow morning to fit the deliveries around the Tuesday closure, after nobody volunteered.
Declare the new premises to the insurer before opening, otherwise the extractor hood work is not covered; nobody took it on.
items.notes: The timing is an event (opening), not a date, so due_text_contains is empty.

items.description: VAT return for the new business: Lucie says Gilles, the accountant, will do it, but he is absent; no participant owns it.
Photos of the dishes for the website: Thomas might take them during the kitchen trials if he has a moment, with no guarantee.
Tasting for the local press before opening: Thomas asked Karim, who would not promise it and changed the subject; nobody owns it.

forbidden.description: Sophie keeping her own spreadsheet for bank reconciliations is a personal choice, not a team decision.
Thomas does not own the food and wine pairings; he only reported what Karim said.
No task, for anyone, to declare the premises to the insurer.
No task for the VAT return: it is assigned to Gilles, who is absent.
The dish photos are not a firm task for Thomas.
No task, for anyone, to organize a press tasting.
Sophie does not own the hygiene training registrations; she declined the suggested handover.
The loyalty card is not a decision; it was deferred.
The oven test is not Lucie's task: she asked, Karim accepted.

forbidden_claims: The new restaurant is closed on Mondays.
Karim sends the final menu, or a menu with desserts, on Friday.
The combi oven test is cancelled or no longer needed.
Sophie handles the hygiene training registrations.
Sophie still has to collect terrace furniture quotes.
Sophie or Lucie files the VAT return.
Thomas has committed to taking the dish photos.
Karim will organize a press tasting.
Keeping a personal spreadsheet for bank reconciliations is a team decision.
A calendar date (day number) is attached to a weekday or 'tomorrow' deadline: Monday oven test, Friday menu, Tuesday pairings, Friday job ads or tomorrow's call.
detail_checks: The second restaurant, on rue des Tanneurs, opens in five weeks.
Kitchen ninety percent delivered; cold room in place; combi oven arrives on Thursday.
The oven test covers steam and convection before signing for the delivery.
Original menu plan: six starters, eight mains and five desserts.
Hiring: three waiters, one dishwasher and two kitchen assistants.
Licence deadline shown on the town hall portal: 2026-11-10.
Terrace for twenty covers; the landlord leaves his tables and chairs.
The fishmonger from Pornic delivers both restaurants three times a week with a five percent volume discount.
Monday lunch is the first restaurant's best service of the week.
The loyalty card will be discussed again in January.
